eventName: Palm seed plantation activity along the banks of the surplus water canal Chembarambakkam Lake
eventDescription:
The experience of touching the soil, planting the seed, and connecting with nature provided a new sense of awareness for many young participants. It was surprising to learn that some students had never seen a palm seed or a palm tree before, but today they became one with nature.
This was not just a seed-planting event?
it became the beginning of an awareness movement
and the continuation of a green revolution.
